verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: Successful indeed are the believers.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
verses.translation: Those who offer their Salat (prayers) with all solemnity and full submissiveness.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.translation: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk, falsehood, and all that Allah has forbidden).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
verses.translation: And those who pay the Zakat .
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.translation: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts, from illegal sexual acts)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.translation: Except from their wives or (the captives and slaves) that their right hands possess, for then, they are free from blame;
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors;
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.translation: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanat (all the duties which Allah has ordained, honesty, moral responsibility and trusts etc.) and to their covenants;
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.translation: And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawat (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.translation: These are indeed the inheritors.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.translation: Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
verses.translation: And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.translation: Thereafter We made him (the offspring of Adam) as a Nutfah (mixed drops of the male and female sexual discharge) (and lodged it) in a safe lodging (womb of the woman).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.translation: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.translation: After that, surely, you will die.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.translation: Then (again), surely, you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed We have created above you seven heavens (one over the other), and We are never unaware of the creation.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.translation: And We sent down from the sky water (rain) in (due) measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are Able to take it away.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translation: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
verses.translation: And a tree (olive) that springs forth from Mount Sinai, that grows oil, and (it is a) relish for the eaters.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translation: And Verily! In the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink (milk) of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous (other) benefits for you, and of them you eat.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: And on them, and on ships you are carried.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people, and he said: “O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him (Islamic Monotheism). Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His Punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: But the chiefs of those who disbelieved among his people said: “He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.translation: “He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.translation: [Nuh (Noah)] said: “O my Lord! Help me because they deny me.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.translation: So We inspired him (saying): “Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and the oven gushes forth water, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: “All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who are Zalimun (i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allah, etc.).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.translation: And say: “My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.translation: Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nuh (Noah)], there are indeed Ayat (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then, after them, We created another generation.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): “Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His Punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.translation: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and to whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: “He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.translation: “If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily! You indeed would be losers.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.translation: “Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resurrected)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: “Far, very far is that which you are promised.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.translation: “There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: “He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allah, but we are not going to believe in him.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.translation: He said: “O my Lord! Help me because they deny me.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.translation: (Allah) said: “In a little while, they are sure to be regretful.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: So As-Saihah (torment – awful cry, etc.) overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, disobedient to His Messengers, etc.).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then, after them, We created other generations.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.translation: No nation can anticipate their term, nor can they delay it.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession, every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Ahadith (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So away with a people who believe not.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: Then We sent Musa (Moses) and his brother Harun (Aaron), with Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.translation: To Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allah).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
verses.translation: They said: “Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like).”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.translation: So they denied them both [Musa (Moses) and Harun (Aaron)] and became of those who were destroyed.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
verses.translation: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, And We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.translation: O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Taiyibat [all kinds of Halal (legal) foods which Allah has made legal (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.], and do righteous deeds. Verily! I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.translation: And verily! This your religion (of Islamic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so keep your duty to Me.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.translation: But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its belief.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.translation: So leave them in their error for a time.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.translation: Do they think that We enlarge them in wealth and children,
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translation: We hasten unto them with good things (in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter)? Nay, but they perceive not.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.translation: Verily! Those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: And those who believe in the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord,
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.translation: And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.translation: And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities, etc., have been accepted or not), because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
verses.translation: It is these who race for the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Salat (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on].
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: And We tax not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.translation: Nay, but their hearts are covered (blind) from understanding this (the Qur’an), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.translation: Until, when We grasp those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment, behold! They make humble invocation with a loud voice.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly, you shall not be helped by Us.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and with hatred to listen to them).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.translation: In pride (they Quraish pagans and polytheists of Makkah used to feel proud that they are the dwellers of Makkah sanctuary Haram), talking evil about it (the Qur’an) by night.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allah, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet ), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.translation: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muhammad ) so they deny him?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.translation: Or say they: “There is madness in him?” Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. “(A) Tauhid: Worshipping Allah Alone in all aspects (B) The Qur’an (C) The religion of Islam,”] but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.translation: And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.translation: Or is it that you (O Muhammad ) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.translation: And certainly, you (O Muhammad ) call them to a Straight Path (true religion Islamic Monotheism).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
verses.translation: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion Islamic Monotheism).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.translation: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allah) with submission to Him.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.translation: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! They will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translation: It is He, Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), sight (eyes), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.translation: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translation: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.translation: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.translation: They said: “When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: “Verily, this we have been promised, we and our fathers before (us)! This is only the tales of the ancients!”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: Say: “Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: They will say: “It is Allah’s!” Say: “Will you not then remember?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: Say: “Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: They will say: “Allah.” Say: “Will you not then fear Allah (believe in His Oneness, obey Him, believe in the Resurrection and Recompense for each and every good or bad deed).”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: Say “In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, (i.e. if Allah saves anyone none can punish or harm him, and if Allah punishes or harms anyone none can save him), if you know.” [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 12, Page 145]
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.translation: They will say: “(All that belongs) to Allah.” Say: “How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.translation: Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islamic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.translation: No son (or offspring or children) did Allah beget, nor is there any ilah (god) along with Him; (if there had been many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all that they attribute to Him!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.translation: All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad ): ” My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened (torment),
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: “My Lord! Then (save me from Your Punishment), and put me not amongst the people who are the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doing).”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muhammad ) that with which We have threatened them.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.translation: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best-Acquainted with the things they utter.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
verses.translation: And say: “My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.translation: “And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.translation: Until, when death comes to one of them (those who join partners with Allah), he says: “My Lord! Send me back,
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.translation: “So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!” No! It is but a word that he speaks, and behind them is Barzakh (a barrier) until the Day when they will be resurrected.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.translation: Then, those whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, – these, they are the successful.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.translation: And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose their ownselves, in Hell will they abide.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
verses.translation: The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: “Were not My Verses (this Qur’an) recited to you, and then you used to deny them?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.translation: They will say: “Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.translation: “Our Lord! Bring us out of this; if ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be Zalimun: (polytheists, oppressors, unjust, and wrong-doers, etc.).”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.translation: He (Allah) will say: “Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.translation: Verily! There was a party of My slaves, who used to say: “Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.translation: But you took them for a laughingstock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.translation: Verily! I have rewarded them this Day for their patience, they are indeed the ones that are successful.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.translation: He (Allah) will say: “What number of years did you stay on earth?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.translation: They will say: “We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account.”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: He (Allah) will say: “You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.translation: “Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.translation: So Exalted be Allah, the True King, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.translation: And whoever invokes (or worships), besides Allah, any other ilah (god), of whom he has no proof, then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely! Al-Kafirun (the disbelievers in Allah and in the Oneness of Allah, polytheists, pagans, idolaters, etc.) will not be successful.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.translation: And say (O Muhammad ): “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali
